field.name: caID
field.comment: The ID of the calendar whose events are listed, or a JSON array of IDs to list the events of more than one (0: the calendar is the one held by the site attribute named by calendarAttributeKeyHandle)

field.name: calendarAttributeKeyHandle
field.comment: The handle of the site attribute holding the calendar whose events are listed (used if caID is empty)

field.name: totalToRetrieve
field.comment: How many events are listed at most

field.name: totalPerPage
field.comment: How many events a page displays

field.name: filterByTopicAttributeKeyID
field.comment: The ID of the topics attribute of the events used to filter them (0: they are not filtered by filterByTopicID)

field.name: filterByTopicID
field.comment: The ID of the topic the events must be assigned to (used if filterByTopicAttributeKeyID is not 0)

field.name: filterByPageTopicAttributeKeyHandle
field.comment: The handle of the topics attribute of the page holding the block: the events must be assigned to the topic it holds (used if filterByTopicAttributeKeyID is 0)

field.name: filterByFeatured
field.comment: true: only the events whose is_featured attribute is set are listed, and that attribute must exist and be indexed; false: all of them are listed

field.name: eventListTitle
field.comment: The text displayed above the list

field.name: linkToPage
field.comment: The ID of the page holding the whole calendar, linked below the list (0: no link)

field.name: titleFormat
field.comment: The HTML element wrapping the text displayed above the list: h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 or p

field.name: eventPeriod
field.comment: future_events: the events that have yet to end are listed; past_events: the ones that are over; all_events: every event

field.name: eventOrder
field.comment: most_recent_first: the events are listed starting from the most recent one; oldest_first: starting from the oldest one
